Requirement REQ-4 (System Features > Torrent Search > Functional Requirements):
Query will retrieve the no. of seed and peers, size of the file, date posted and a link to the webpage itself.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Torrent where
  seed  : Nat
  peer  : Nat
  size  : Nat
  date  : String
  link  : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  query          : String
  torrents       : List Torrent
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  results       : List Torrent
  message       : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- an item may be returned: it matches the query and its fields are non-empty
def Wanted (i : Input) (t : Torrent) : Bool :=
  i.query == "" ∨ t.seed ≠ 0 ∨ t.peer ≠ 0 ∨ t.size ≠ 0 ∨ t.date ≠ "" ∨ t.link ≠ ""

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.query ≠ ""
  post := fun i o =>
    (∀ t ∈ o.results, t ∈ i.torrents ∧ Wanted i t = true) ∧
    (o.results.length < 100 → ∀ t ∈ i.torrents, Wanted i t = true → t ∈ o.results) ∧
    o.results.length ≤ 100 ∧
    List.Pairwise (fun a b => a.seed ≥ b.seed ∧ a.peer ≥ b.peer ∧ a.size ≥ b.size) o.results ∧
    (o.message = "No results were found." ↔ o.results = [])

          Spec.post { query := "cats", torrents := [{ seed := 10, peer := 20, size := 500, date := "2023-01-01", link := "http://example.com" },

structure Video where
  title   : String
  duration: Nat
  date    : String
  order   : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  videos  : List Video
  order   : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  results : List Video
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- An item is in the results if its order matches the criteria
def InResults (i : Input) (v : Video) : Bool :=
  v.order = i.order

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.order ∈ ["length", "date", "title"]
  post := fun i o =>
    List.Pairwise (fun a b => a.order ≤ b.order) o.results ∧
    (∀ v ∈ o.results, v ∈ i.videos ∧ InResults i v = true)

example : Spec.pre { videos := [{ title := "A", duration := 5, date := "2023-01-01", order := "title" },
                                 { title := "B", duration := 3, date := "2023-02-01", order := "title" }],
                     order := "title" } ∧
          Spec.post { videos := [{ title := "A", duration := 5, date := "2023-01-01", order := "title" },
                                  { title := "B", duration := 3, date := "2023-02-01", order := "title" }],
                      order := "title" }
                    { results := [{ title := "A", duration := 5, date := "2023-01-01", order := "title" },
                                  { title := "B", duration := 3, date := "2023-02-01", order := "title" }] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
